report.summary: tests/test_killswitch.py: Contains integration tests for KillSwitch, verifying stop semantics, latency, and undefeatability via pytest.
risks: CLAIMS|tests/test_killswitch.py|The kill switch must actually stop things, and the latency must be MEASURED.
CLAIMS|tests/test_killswitch.py|Measured numbers are printed and asserted, so the bound is enforced on every run rather than admired once.
READS|tests/test_killswitch.py|The killswitch file path via Path operations.
SMELL|tests/test_killswitch.py|Multiple test functions for similar stop conditions are repetitively written instead of being parameterized.
todos: tests/test_killswitch.py|function|test_allow_armed_switch_permits_work|Verifies that an armed switch allows work.
tests/test_killswitch.py|function|test_allow_watcher_does_not_trip_a_healthy_switch|Verifies watcher does not latch a healthy switch.
tests/test_killswitch.py|function|test_allow_gate_runs_to_completion_under_an_armed_switch|Verifies pytest runs to completion with an armed switch.
